exposure: female GS patients who delivered after disease symptom onset
cohort: 101 GS patients from the National Rare Diseases Registry System of China (NRSC)
finding: Female GS patients tend to have less severe symptoms compared to males and experience generally favorable pregnancy outcomes, although they require closer monitoring and potassium supplementation, especially during the first trimester.
mod_finding: The study found that both cesarean section and vaginal delivery were safe for pregnant women with Gitelman syndrome.
